      November 9, 2026

      Why can bipolar disorder go undiagnosed for years?

      The condition affects 36 million people around the world, yet it can be surprisingly difficult to recognize—for both patients and healthcare professionals. Learn why Johnson & Johnson continues to advance approaches for this often-misunderstood mental health disorder.
      Read more
    • Health & wellness
      October 28, 2026

      How a family history of heart disease and stroke drives the work of 3 Johnson & Johnson scientists

      Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death around the world. For Roberta Chapman, Alistair Lindsay and JoAnne Foody the pursuit of better treatments is both a professional mission and a deeply personal one.
      Read more
    • Innovation
      October 27, 2026

      More than memory loss: 5 things we now know about Alzheimer’s disease

      Scientists are better understanding the neuropsychiatric changes that strike up to 97% of patients diagnosed with this degenerative brain disease. Here’s what to know about these often distressing symptoms, and why Johnson & Johnson is working on a solution.
